description: This file defines a React functional component for a chat page in a messaging application. It manages chat data retrieval, message sending with optimistic UI updates, reaction handling, and UI rendering including header, message list, and input components.

classes.name: ChatPage
classes.description: React functional component implementing the chat interface for a specific chat thread, handling data fetching, message sending, reactions, and rendering the chat UI.

methods.name: ChatPage
methods.description: React component function initializing state, effects, and handlers for chat interactions.

methods.name: handleSendMessage
methods.description: Handles sending a message, performs optimistic UI update, and reverts on error.

methods.name: handleAddReaction
methods.description: Handles adding or toggling reactions on messages locally.
